title: The Windows holder runs as a service the service control manager owns: an owner-only named pipe discovered as a pipe address, hello with the same contract as a Unix socket, and programs that outlive the job of the client that asked for them

declared_cases.summary: service status is stopped and installs nothing; service install and start run the holder under the manager as the fixture account; the record names a \\.\pipe\ address; a launcher in a kill-on-close job starts a ConPTY program through the holder pipe and is terminated; a new core adopts the same pid and start token and reads the marker; hello over the control pipe answers and pipelined requests share one connection; service stop ends the holder and uninstall removes the service.

hello with another runtime's credential is invalid_credential or unauthenticated and nothing runs; another account and the anonymous token cannot open the pipe; a second listener never joins a claimed name; a record whose holder is gone is stale_endpoint and is left in place; a null or foreign DACL is refused at admission.
